summary: Conditional over-count: gate count=8 on redundancy detection
hypothesis: Gating exp046's count=8 over-produce on detected redundancy should preserve the pure champion's atom-5 drafts on clean cases while still fixing redundant ones, weakly dominating exp046's blanket over-count.
technique: A deterministic Swift gate runs exp046's high-recall redundancy union over the pure greedy count=7 draft; if no redundant pair is detected the draft is returned verbatim, otherwise the pipeline falls back to exp046's full count=8-then-dedup fix.
result: Scored 0.409 on the full-30 greedy eval (3 wins / 3 ties / 23 losses vs Sonnet, 1 refusal), −0.021 below champion exp046 (0.430) and identical to the bare count=7 champion. Rubric showed atom 4 / spec 3 / nonRed 3 / cov 3 / nat 4 — both spec and nonRed fell back from exp046's held 4s — confirming the hypothesis was falsified: the redundancy gate almost never fired because the detector under-fires on the low-overlap paraphrase pairs that are the native champion's actual redundancies, so exp052 degenerated to the bare champion. Discarded.
